MOD = 1000000007

    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    p = list(map(int, input[1:]))

    adj = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(1, n):
        adj[p[i]].append(i + 1)

    def dfs(node):
        if not adj[node]:
            return 2
        counts = [dfs(child) for child in adj[node]]
        total = 1
        for count in counts:
            total = total * (count + 1) % MOD
        return total

    print(dfs(1) % MOD)
